rationale: Race is an in-scope California fiber-to-the-home operating platform. Munich Re's audited holdings and insurance-regulatory evidence establish MEAG-managed MR Redwood as an active 7.1264% parent-equity investor, while company and Oak Hill evidence support continuing Oak Hill majority control and distinguish AllianceBernstein's private-credit financing from ownership.

repoReconciliation.preserveBoundary: Race Communications at the manager-level platform; exclude holdcos, operating subsidiaries, local networks, SPVs and absorbed add-ons

proposalGuardrails: Create Race only once and map the MEAG census holding to the same canonical company.
Record MEAG/Munich Re through MR Redwood at 7.1264% parent equity; do not describe AllianceBernstein private credit as ownership.
Record Oak Hill as current majority controller without inventing a current exact percentage or fund allocation.
Use 2024 as MEAG's entry year but keep the legal closing date not publicly disclosed.
Do not create Race holdcos, Race subsidiaries, Atherton Fiber or local network assets as separate PortCos.
Do not infer undisclosed equity amount, unit class, voting/preference terms or observer rights.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: MEAG investment amount and legal closing date
MR Redwood unit, voting, preference and observer terms
Oak Hill exact current percentage and final fund allocation
recommendedNextAction: Prepare one later protected new-company proposal for Race Communications with MEAG/Munich Re and Oak Hill as the two current owners, preserving the platform boundary and evidence limitations.
